subject: POC readiness checklist & MAP alignment — CardioHealth network prerequisites
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@cardiohealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC readiness checklist & MAP alignment — CardioHealth network prerequisites

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. To keep the POC timeline tight, I pulled together an initial mutual action plan focused on the environment items we discussed: org setup, API keys, IP allow-listing, and VPC peering. I attached a short MAP spreadsheet that breaks tasks into owner, SLA, and blocking dependencies.

Top asks for your infra team (requested by EOW):
- Confirm the CIDR range you can expose for peering and any compliance gating for firewall rules.
- Provide a short list of egress IPs to allow (we can provide recommended NAT ranges).
- Confirm whether you want Redwood to create the service account for peering or if you'll create it on your side.

From our side we will:
- Provision a trial org and seed API keys for the evaluation.
- Stand up a dedicated tenant for the POC in us-west-2 and prepare a v1 model bundle.
- Share a prewritten peering template and a test ACL for your network team.

Proposed dates:
- Org + API keys: by Tue 7/8
- IP allowlist & firewall tests: Wed 7/9–Thu 7/10
- VPC peering handshake: target Fri 7/11 (can be same-day if your infra is ready)

If this looks reasonable, can you loop in whoever owns VPC peering and the network contact so we can schedule the 30–45 minute preflight?

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CardioHealth_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (xlsx), cardio-network-diagram.png (png)
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@cardiohealth.com>

Cc: Rajesh Patel <r.patel@cardiohealth.com>, Sophie Green <sophie.green@cardiohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jul 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC readiness checklist & MAP alignment — CardioHealth network prerequisites

Marcus —

Appreciate the clear rundown. I’ve looped in Rajesh (infra) and Sophie (security). A few quick notes:
- CIDR: we can allocate a /24 for peering. Rajesh will confirm exact range Monday.
- NAT / egress IPs: we have a small pool (3 IPs) we can add to your allowlist for the POC; will share the values after change window on Monday.
- Service account: we’d prefer Redwood to provision the peer role, then we’ll accept and attach the routing. Simpler for our operations cadence.

We should lock the preflight on Tue 7/8 at 10:00am PT. Does that work for your infra lead?

Emily Chen
Head of Cloud Infrastructure
CardioHealth

Hi Emily / Rajesh —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Tue 7/8 10:00am PT is perfect for us; I’ll send a calendar invite with the agenda. Agenda items I suggest: 1) CIDR confirmation, 2) who will create the peering service account, 3) firewall rule test plan and rollback, 4) expected test traffic and metrics to validate latency + egress.

For the API keys: Marcus will provision scoped test keys (read/generate only) and share via a secure link (DocuSign/Drive restricted). If CardioHealth needs longer-lived keys for automated end-to-end tests we can create ephemeral keys with a 72-hour TTL and a token refresh callback.

Action items pending:
- Rajesh: confirm CIDR + 3 NAT IPs by EOD Mon 7/7 (noted your change window)
- Marcus: create MAP v0.4 incorporating timeline and owners

Team —

Quick update from infra: CIDR for peering is 10.240.12.0/24. Egress NAT addresses we can allocate for the test are: 34.201.12.47, 34.201.12.48, 34.201.12.49. We will create the acceptance rules in our firewall sandbox and coordinate the live cut during the Tue 10:00 preflight.

Regarding service account: we are fine with Redwood creating the peer role; please include the IAM policy you require so we can pre-approve.

I’ll join the 10:00 preflight and bring our network engineer (Sophie).

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 09 Jul 2025 16:47:00 -07:00

Thanks everyone — good preflight. Summary and next steps (from the meeting):
- Redwood to create the POC tenant and seed API keys by Thu 7/10 18:00 PT (we will send via secure Drive link).
- CardioHealth to approve IAM policy for the peering service account (Rajesh) — target Wed 7/9 EOD.
- Firewall: CardioHealth will apply the three NAT IP allowlist entries in sandbox; Redwood will perform a smoke test from our staging endpoint, then a controlled run from the POC tenant.
- VPC peering handshake scheduled Fri 7/11 11:00am PT; expected rollout window Fri 7/11 11:00–12:30.
- Acceptance criteria for close: successful token-authenticated inference call <200ms P50 and successful pass of end-to-end write/read test using seeded dataset. If these pass, we move to evaluation reporting and billing trial.

I updated the MAP spreadsheet and uploaded v0.4 to the shared drive link. Attaching the SOW draft for procurement to review. Also linking the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/CH-2025-089

Jordan Blake
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
